notes.title: Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward – Preparing for Full Release
notes.content:
Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward – Preparing for Full Release
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622243/b307153f44835eb4b4301eb5e702499facc0b624.png"]





Hello players,
We are now entering the final stages before the full release. To deliver the best possible experience, we’ve been refining gameplay, adding content, and polishing every detail.

About the Game
Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward is a strategic defense game where Luna and Sol guard the corrupted gate against endless waves of nightmares.

Recruit allies, set traps and unique gimmicks to build your defense.

Use Luna and Sol’s stylish action and powerful skills to defeat enemies.

Face new challenges and strategies across diverse stages.

The full release is not the end, but the beginning. More updates and improvements are planned, and your wishlist and support mean the world to us.
